import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";

const C = {
  cream:  "#F7F4EE",
  ink:    "#1A1814",
  mid:    "#8A8278",
  deep:   "#5c564e",
  faint:  "#B5AFA5",
  stone:  "#E8E3DA",
  warm:   "#F0EBE2",
  gold:   "#C4A97D",
  lost:   "#9B4D3C",
  serif:  "'Cormorant Garamond', serif",
  sans:   "'DM Sans', sans-serif",
};

function Fade({ show, delay = 0, ms = 800, y = 14, children, style = {} }) {
  return (
    <div style={{
      opacity: show ? 1 : 0,
      transform: show ? "translateY(0)" : `translateY(${y}px)`,
      transition: `opacity ${ms}ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) ${delay}ms, transform ${ms}ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) ${delay}ms`,
      ...style,
    }}>{children}</div>
  );
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════
//  SCREEN 1 — THE QUESTION
// ══════════════════════════════════════════
function Screen1({ onNext }) {
  const [hrs, setHrs] = useState("");
  const [in_, setIn] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => { setTimeout(() => setIn(true), 250); }, []);

  const tap = n => { if (hrs.length < 2) setHrs(hrs + String(n)); };
  const del = () => setHrs(hrs.slice(0, -1));
  const v = parseInt(hrs) || 0;
  const ok = v >= 1 && v <= 18;

  return (
    <div style={{ width: "100%", height: "100%", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", background: C.cream }}>
      <div style={{
        flex: 1, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column",
        alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center",
        padding: "0 36px", textAlign: "center",
      }}>
        <Fade show={in_} delay={200}>
          <h1 style={{
            fontFamily: C.serif, fontSize: 27, fontWeight: 400,
            lineHeight: 1.35, color: C.ink, maxWidth: 300,
          }}>
            How many hours a day does your phone take without you noticing?
          </h1>
        </Fade>

        <Fade show={in_} delay={550}>
          <p style={{ fontFamily: C.sans, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 400, color: C.deep, marginTop: 14, lineHeight: 1.65, maxWidth: 296 }}>
            The hours you won't even remember spending, lost to mindless scrolling and absent-minded pickups, add up.
          </p>
        </Fade>

        <Fade show={in_} delay={750}>
          <div style={{ marginTop: 44, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", alignItems: "center" }}>
            <div style={{
              fontFamily: C.serif, fontSize: 76, fontWeight: 400,
              letterSpacing: "0.01em",
              fontVariantNumeric: "lining-nums",
              height: 90, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center",
              lineHeight: 1,
            }}>
              <span style={{ color: hrs ? C.ink : C.faint }}>{hrs || "0"}</span>
            </div>
            <span style={{
              fontFamily: C.sans, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 500,
              color: C.gold, letterSpacing: "0.12em", textTransform: "uppercase", marginTop: 4,
            }}>Hours</span>
          </div>
        </Fade>
      </div>

      <Fade show={in_} delay={950} y={20}>
        <div style={{ padding: "10px 20px 30px", background: C.warm, borderRadius: "20px 20px 0 0" }}>
          <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(3,1fr)", gap: 7 }}>
            {[1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9].map(n => (
              <button key={n} onClick={() => tap(n)} style={{
                padding: "13px 0", background: C.cream, border: "none",
                borderRadius: 12, cursor: "pointer",
                fontFamily: C.sans, fontSize: 19, fontWeight: 400, color: C.ink,
              }}>{n}</button>
            ))}
            <div />
            <button onClick={() => tap(0)} style={{
              padding: "13px 0", background: C.cream, border: "none",
              borderRadius: 12, cursor: "pointer",
              fontFamily: C.sans, fontSize: 19, fontWeight: 400, color: C.ink,
            }}>0</button>
            <button onClick={del} aria-label="Delete" style={{
              padding: "13px 0", background: "transparent", border: "none",
              borderRadius: 12, cursor: "pointer",
              display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center",
            }}>
              <svg width="24" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 18" fill="none">
                <path d="M8 1.5H21C21.8 1.5 22.5 2.2 22.5 3V15C22.5 15.8 21.8 16.5 21 16.5H8L1.5 9L8 1.5Z"
                  stroke={C.ink} strokeWidth="1.3" strokeLinejoin="round" />
                <path d="M11.5 6.5L17 11.5M17 6.5L11.5 11.5" stroke={C.ink} strokeWidth="1.3" strokeLinecap="round" />
              </svg>
            </button>
          </div>
          <button onClick={() => ok && onNext(v)} style={{
            width: "100%", marginTop: 10, padding: "14px 0",
            background: ok ? C.ink : C.stone, border: "none", borderRadius: 28,
            fontFamily: C.sans, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 500,
            color: ok ? C.cream : C.mid, letterSpacing: "0.02em",
            cursor: ok ? "pointer" : "default", transition: "all 0.3s",
          }}>Continue</button>
        </div>
      </Fade>
    </div>
  );
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════
//  SCREEN 2 — THE TRUTH
// ══════════════════════════════════════════
function Screen2({ hours, onNext }) {
  const [in_, setIn] = useState(false);
  const [filled, setFilled] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    setTimeout(() => setIn(true), 200);
    setTimeout(() => setFilled(true), 1100);
  }, []);

  const life = 90;
  const sleep = Math.round(life * (8 / 24)); // 30 years
  const screenRaw = Math.round(life * (hours / 24));
  const screen = Math.min(screenRaw, life - sleep); // never overflow the grid

  const grid = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < life; i++) {
    if (i < sleep) grid.push("sleep");
    else if (i < sleep + screen) grid.push("screen");
    else grid.push("living");
  }

  return (
    <div style={{
      width: "100%", height: "100%",
      display: "flex", flexDirection: "column",
      alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center",
      padding: "20px 28px", textAlign: "center", background: C.cream,
    }}>
      <Fade show={in_} delay={200}>
        <h1 style={{
          fontFamily: C.serif, fontSize: 25, fontWeight: 400,
          lineHeight: 1.35, color: C.ink, maxWidth: 320,
        }}>
          <span style={{ fontVariantNumeric: "lining-nums" }}>{hours}</span> {hours === 1 ? "hour" : "hours"} a day becomes{" "}
          <span style={{ color: C.lost, fontWeight: 500, fontVariantNumeric: "lining-nums" }}>{screen} {screen === 1 ? "year" : "years"}</span>
          {" "}of your life.
        </h1>
      </Fade>

      <Fade show={in_} delay={500}>
        <p style={{ fontFamily: C.sans, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 400, color: C.deep, marginTop: 10 }}>
          Each square is one year of a 90-year life.
        </p>
      </Fade>

      <Fade show={in_} delay={750}>
        <div style={{
          marginTop: 26, display: "grid",
          gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(9, 1fr)",
          gap: 5, maxWidth: 256,
          justifyItems: "center",
        }}>
          {grid.map((t, i) => {
            let bg = C.stone;
            let border = "1.5px solid transparent";
            if (filled) {
              if (t === "sleep") bg = C.ink;
              else if (t === "screen") bg = C.lost;
              else { bg = "transparent"; border = `1.5px solid ${C.mid}`; }
            }
            return (
              <div key={i} style={{
                width: 22, height: 22, borderRadius: 4,
                background: bg, border,
                transition: `background .35s ease ${i * 18}ms, border .35s ease ${i * 18}ms`,
              }} />
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </Fade>

      {/* Legend — evenly spaced and centred */}
      <Fade show={filled} delay={300}>
        <div style={{
          display: "flex", justifyContent: "center", alignItems: "center",
          gap: 24, marginTop: 22,
        }}>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 8 }}>
            <div style={{ width: 12, height: 12, borderRadius: 3, background: C.ink }} />
            <span style={{ fontFamily: C.sans, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 400, color: C.ink }}>Sleep</span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 8 }}>
            <div style={{ width: 12, height: 12, borderRadius: 3, background: C.lost }} />
            <span style={{ fontFamily: C.sans, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 400, color: C.ink }}>Lost time</span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 8 }}>
            <div style={{ width: 12, height: 12, borderRadius: 3, background: "transparent", border: `1.5px solid ${C.mid}` }} />
            <span style={{ fontFamily: C.sans, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 400, color: C.ink }}>Living</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Fade>

      {/* Bottom text */}
      <Fade show={filled} delay={800} ms={1200}>
        <p style={{
          fontFamily: C.sans, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 400,
          color: C.ink, marginTop: 26,
          lineHeight: 1.6, maxWidth: 285,
        }}>
          That time was engineered away by apps built to steal your attention, pulling you away from the people and goals that matter most.
        </p>
      </Fade>

      <Fade show={filled} delay={1400}>
        <button onClick={onNext} style={{
          marginTop: 28, marginBottom: 4, padding: "14px 48px",
          background: C.ink, border: "none", borderRadius: 28,
          fontFamily: C.sans, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 500,
          color: C.cream, letterSpacing: "0.02em", cursor: "pointer",
          flexShrink: 0,
        }}>Continue</button>
      </Fade>
    </div>
  );
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════
//  SCREEN 3 — THE MESSAGE (FINAL SCREEN)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════
function Screen3() {
  const [p, setP] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    setTimeout(() => setP(1), 500);
    setTimeout(() => setP(2), 2000);
    setTimeout(() => setP(3), 3400);
    setTimeout(() => setP(4), 5000);
    setTimeout(() => setP(5), 6400);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div style={{
      width: "100%", height: "100%",
      display: "flex", flexDirection: "column",
      alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center",
      padding: "32px 40px", textAlign: "center", background: C.cream,
    }}>
      <Fade show={p >= 1} delay={0} ms={1400} y={10}>
        <h1 style={{
          fontFamily: C.serif, fontSize: 28, fontWeight: 400,
          lineHeight: 1.35, color: C.ink,
        }}>
          Your time, back in your hands.
        </h1>
      </Fade>

      <Fade show={p >= 2} delay={0} ms={1200} y={10}>
        <p style={{
          fontFamily: C.serif, fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 400,
          color: C.ink, marginTop: 26,
          lineHeight: 1.5, maxWidth: 330, letterSpacing: "0.01em",
        }}>
          Thank you for taking this first step toward focus and presence.
        </p>
      </Fade>

      <Fade show={p >= 3} delay={0} ms={1200} y={8}>
        <p style={{
          fontFamily: C.serif, fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 400,
          color: C.ink, marginTop: 20,
          lineHeight: 1.5, maxWidth: 330, letterSpacing: "0.01em",
        }}>
          What truly matters is waiting on the other side: more time and attention for the people around you, and for the goals you've been meaning to reach.
        </p>
      </Fade>

      <Fade show={p >= 4} delay={0} ms={1600} y={4}>
        <p style={{
          fontFamily: C.serif, fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 600,
          color: C.gold,
          marginTop: 36, letterSpacing: "0.02em",
        }}>
          The key is yours.
        </p>
      </Fade>

      <Fade show={p >= 5} delay={0} ms={800}>
        <button style={{
          marginTop: 40, marginBottom: 4, padding: "13px 44px",
          background: "transparent",
          border: `1px solid ${C.mid}`,
          borderRadius: 28, cursor: "pointer",
          fontFamily: C.sans, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 500,
          color: C.ink, letterSpacing: "0.02em",
          transition: "all 0.25s", flexShrink: 0,
        }}
          onMouseEnter={e => { e.currentTarget.style.background = C.ink; e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = C.ink; e.currentTarget.style.color = C.cream; }}
          onMouseLeave={e => { e.currentTarget.style.background = "transparent"; e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = C.mid; e.currentTarget.style.color = C.ink; }}
        >
          Begin
        </button>
      </Fade>
    </div>
  );
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════
//  SPLASH — first run only
//  Gate on the same flag as onboarding (e.g. hasCompletedOnboarding):
//  false → splash → onboarding; true → straight to app, no splash.
//
//  The splash is the founder-supplied artwork (full-bleed image), NOT a
//  coded logo — this guarantees the exact wordmark, colour and orange
//  flask with zero font/emoji drift across devices.
//
//  Asset: splash@3x.png — provide at 1290×2796 (iPhone Pro Max @3x).
//  Displayed aspect-fill + centred so it fills every device without
//  distortion; the logo sits dead-centre with wide margins, so the slight
//  top/bottom crop on other aspect ratios never touches it.
//
//  Timing: fade-in 600ms → hold 2700ms → fade-out 500ms cross-dissolve
//  into Screen 1 (~3.8s total). Founder-set duration.
// ══════════════════════════════════════════
// Splash artwork: the founder-supplied 1290×2796 PNG, FULLY EMBEDDED below
// as base64 so this file is complete and copy-pasteable on its own — no
// separate asset needed. (In the native build you may extract it to a
// bundled asset for app-size hygiene; visually identical either way.)
const SPLASH_SRC = "data:image/png;base64,";

function Splash({ onDone }) {
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState(0); // 0 = hidden, 1 = visible, 2 = fading out
  useEffect(() => {
    const t1 = setTimeout(() => setPhase(1), 60);
    const t2 = setTimeout(() => setPhase(2), 60 + 600 + 2700);
    const t3 = setTimeout(onDone, 60 + 600 + 2700 + 500);
    return () => { clearTimeout(t1); clearTimeout(t2); clearTimeout(t3); };
  }, [onDone]);

  return (
    <div style={{
      position: "absolute", inset: 0,
      background: C.cream,
      opacity: phase === 1 ? 1 : 0,
      transition: phase === 2 ? "opacity 0.5s ease" : "opacity 0.6s ease",
    }}>
      <img
        src={SPLASH_SRC}
        alt="FocusKey by Presence Labs"
        style={{
          width: "100%", height: "100%",
          objectFit: "cover", objectPosition: "center",
          display: "block",
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════
//  MAIN
// ══════════════════════════════════════════
export default function Onboarding() {
  const [scr, setScr] = useState("splash");
  const [hrs, setHrs] = useState(5);
  const [fade, setFade] = useState(false);

  const go = useCallback((next) => {
    setFade(true);
    setTimeout(() => { setScr(next); setFade(false); }, 350);
  }, []);

  const view = () => {
    switch (scr) {
      // Splash handles its own 500ms fade-out, then s1 mounts directly —
      // s1's staggered fade-ins complete the cross-dissolve (no extra fade here).
      case "splash": return <Splash onDone={() => setScr("s1")} />;
      case "s1": return <Screen1 onNext={h => { setHrs(h); go("s2"); }} />;
      case "s2": return <Screen2 hours={hrs} onNext={() => go("s3")} />;
      case "s3": return <Screen3 />;
      default: return null;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div style={{
      width: "100%", minHeight: "100vh",
      display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center",
      background: "#e4dfd7", padding: "24px 16px", fontFamily: C.sans,
    }}>
      <style>{`
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;0,600;1,300;1,400;1,600&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500&display=swap');
        *,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
        body{margin:0}::-webkit-scrollbar{width:0;height:0}
      `}</style>

      <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", alignItems: "center", gap: 16 }}>
        <div style={{
          width: 375, height: 812, borderRadius: 44,
          border: `1px solid ${C.stone}`,
          boxShadow: "0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)",
          position: "relative", overflow: "hidden",
          display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", background: C.cream,
        }}>
          <div style={{
            height: 54, flexShrink: 0,
            display: "flex", alignItems: "flex-end", justifyContent: "space-between",
            padding: "0 28px 8px", zIndex: 10,
          }}>
            <span style={{ fontFamily: C.sans, fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 600, color: C.ink, opacity: 0.8 }}>9:41</span>
            <div style={{ width: 120, height: 32, borderRadius: 20, background: "rgba(0,0,0,0.08)" }} />
            <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 4, alignItems: "center", opacity: 0.3 }}>
              <svg width="16" height="12" viewBox="0 0 16 12" fill="none">
                <rect x="0" y="6" width="3" height="6" rx="1" fill={C.ink} />
                <rect x="4.5" y="4" width="3" height="8" rx="1" fill={C.ink} />
                <rect x="9" y="1.5" width="3" height="10.5" rx="1" fill={C.ink} />
                <rect x="13" y="0" width="3" height="12" rx="1" fill={C.ink} />
              </svg>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{
            flex: 1, overflow: "hidden",
            opacity: fade ? 0 : 1, transition: "opacity 0.3s ease",
          }}>
            {view()}
          </div>

          {/* Home indicator floats OVER the content — content owns the true
              bottom edge, so the keypad panel runs flush with no colour gap. */}
          <div style={{
            position: "absolute", bottom: 8, left: 0, right: 0,
            display: "flex", justifyContent: "center",
            zIndex: 20, pointerEvents: "none",
          }}>
            <div style={{ width: 100, height: 4, borderRadius: 2, background: "rgba(0,0,0,0.14)" }} />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
